name: Can I convert a detached garage?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert a detached garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, detached garage conversions are permitted as backyard ADUs with independent access, utilities, and 4-ft setbacks (reduced from standard residential setbacks).
